summary_en: 400,000 shares to be cancelled effective 2026-10-31. Cancellation represents 10.8% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury), based on 3,707,481 shares ex-treasury as of 2026-07-31.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: Asahipen Corporation announced on 2026-08-07 that its board of directors resolved to cancel 400,000 treasury shares pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act (会社法第178条). The cancellation is scheduled to take effect on 2026-10-31. As of 2026-07-31, the company held 792,519 treasury shares against 3,707,481 shares outstanding (excluding treasury). The 400,000 shares represent 10.8% of outstanding shares on an ex-treasury basis. No rationale or other commercial context is disclosed in the filing.
